evals.name: tallybook-instagram-reel
evals.prompt: hey, we're launching tallybook next week (the repo is at evals/fixtures/tallybook). can you make an instagram reel for it? people scroll fast so it has to grab attention right away, but it still needs to explain what the app actually does. give me the mp4 and a cover image.
evals.expected_output: A 9:16 1080x1920 MP4 reel, 15-40 s, with a hook visible in the first 0.5 s, punch captions that respect the reading floor, the product's real UI (from the fixture's tokens and components) filling the frame, a how-it-works moment, sound, loudness near -14 LUFS, a CTA end card, plus a 1080x1920 cover with key content inside the centered 3:4.

assertions.name: reel-is-9x16-1080x1920
assertions.check: ffprobe: width 1080, height 1920

assertions.name: reel-length-15-to-40s
assertions.check: ffprobe duration between 15 and 40 s

assertions.name: reel-has-audio-near-minus-14-lufs
assertions.check: audio stream present; integrated loudness between -17 and -12 LUFS; true peak <= -1 dBTP

assertions.name: hook-text-visible-by-half-second
assertions.check: a still at 0.5 s shows large on-screen text

assertions.name: uses-product-brand
assertions.check: stills use the fixture's accent green #1f9d6a / off-white background or its real strings (e.g. 'settle up', 'split evenly')

assertions.name: shows-how-it-works
assertions.check: some scene shows the add-expense or settle-up flow in the product UI, not just claims

assertions.name: captions-in-safe-zone
assertions.check: no caption text in the bottom 380 px or the right 140 px at the marks checked

assertions.name: cover-1080x1920
assertions.check: cover image exists at 1080x1920 with title inside the middle 1080x1440

assertions.name: stills-reviewed
assertions.check: the run rendered stills/contact sheets and looked at them before the final render

evals.name: tallybook-landing-showcase
evals.prompt: make a ~60 second product video for tallybook's landing page and youtube (repo: evals/fixtures/tallybook). assume the viewer has never heard of us. 16:9, and we want it to feel apple-level polished, with sound.
evals.expected_output: A 16:9 1920x1080 MP4, ~45-75 s, comprehension-first: hook, problem shown, reveal with the tagline, how it works in the rebuilt UI with cursor and camera, 2-4 features, end card with tallybook.example; calm captions held at least words/3+1 s; sound designed in code at roughly -16 to -18 LUFS; a scene table in the project README.

assertions.name: showcase-is-1920x1080
assertions.check: ffprobe: 1920x1080

assertions.name: showcase-length-45-to-75s
assertions.check: duration between 45 and 75 s

assertions.name: has-audio-calm-loudness
assertions.check: audio present; integrated loudness between -20 and -14 LUFS; true peak <= -1 dBTP

assertions.name: caption-reading-floor
assertions.check: every caption is on screen at least words/3 + 1 seconds (from cuts/captions source)

assertions.name: rebuilt-ui-not-screenshots
assertions.check: product UI is built as components from the fixture's tokens/strings

assertions.name: cursor-and-camera
assertions.check: a cursor clicks through the UI and the camera pushes in on the subject at least once

assertions.name: end-card-with-url
assertions.check: final seconds show tallybook.example and a call to action

assertions.name: scene-table-documented
assertions.check: the project README contains a scene table with seconds and captions

evals.name: tallybook-loop-and-audio-reference
evals.prompt: i need a short seamless loop of the 'add expense' flow for the hero section of our site (repo at evals/fixtures/tallybook), plus a 10 second feature clip of the same flow with sound. i like this swoosh: evals/fixtures/refs/swoosh.wav, make the clip's sounds feel like that.
evals.expected_output: A seamless 4-10 s loop (first frame equals last) with web-ready MP4/WebM (and optionally a GIF), plus a ~10 s feature clip with sound whose whooshes are derived from the reference (analyzed, described back, grown or placed), with a short plain-words report of how the reference was used.

assertions.name: loop-is-seamless
assertions.check: first and last frame of the loop are (near) identical

assertions.name: loop-length-4-to-10s
assertions.check: loop duration 4-10 s

assertions.name: loop-web-formats
assertions.check: an MP4 (H.264) and a WebM or GIF of the loop exist

assertions.name: clip-about-10s-with-audio
assertions.check: feature clip 8-12 s with an audio stream

assertions.name: reference-analyzed-and-described
assertions.check: the run analyzed swoosh.wav and described its character in plain words

assertions.name: whooshes-derived-from-reference
assertions.check: the clip's whooshes are the reference placed peak-aligned or variants grown from it, not unrelated synthesized noise

assertions.name: no-repeated-identical-sample
assertions.check: if the swoosh is used more than twice, the uses are distinct variants
